zh_before: 由此我们已经认识到，兵的作用绝不只是施加局面压力、控制某种颜色的格，或为子力提供便利的据点；兵本身也是强大的进攻手段。子力发起的进攻若得不到兵的积极支援，往往会撞上敌兵构成的防御屏障而归于失败。因此，兵在进攻中的主要任务之一，就是清除计划攻击区域内对手的防御兵线。如果兵的攻击针对易位后的王翼阵地，它往往会对暴露的王直接形成将杀威胁。
zh_after: 前文已经说明，兵的作用不仅在于施加局面压力、控制某种颜色的格，或为子力提供便利的据点；兵本身也是强大的进攻力量。缺少兵的积极支援，子力的进攻往往会受阻于对方的兵屏障，最终失败。因此，兵在进攻中的主要任务之一，就是清除预定攻击区域中的防御兵线。若兵的攻击指向对方易位后的阵地，还常能暴露敌王，制造直接的将杀威胁。
en_before: And so we have convinced ourselves that the role of the pawn in no way amounts to positional pressure, the control of squares of a certain colour, securing a handy base for piece forces; the pawns are also a powerful 1 means of attack. Without active pawn support, a piece attack often turns out to be doomed to failure, running up against a defensive bristle of enemy pawns. Consequently, one of the main attacking tasks of pawns is the removal of the opponent's defensive pawn line in the sector serving as an object of a planned attack. If, however, such a pawn attack is launched against castling, then it often leads to the creation of direct mating threats to the exposed king.

zh_before: 破坏冲兵是对抗楔子的基本方法。仔细评估位置将决定楔形结构是有利还是不利。当然，楔形允许获得空间并限制对手，但同时限制了动态资源，相反，由于在王翼上进行活跃的兵行动的明确前景，增加了敌人的动态资源。仅仅为了稍微限制对手而构建楔子是不值得的。只有在可以指望保留主动权或至少有可能阻止敌人f-兵前进的情况下，建造楔子才是合理的。
zh_after: 冲起f兵打击兵楔的根基，是对抗兵楔的主要方法。建立兵楔是否有利，必须仔细判断具体局面。兵楔固然能争取空间、压缩对手的活动，却也会减少己方的动态选择；对手反而有了在王翼积极运用兵的明确方向。仅仅为了稍微压缩对手，通常不值得建立兵楔。只有能够保持主动权，或至少有办法阻止对方冲起f兵时，这种兵形才有充分依据。
en_before: The undermining advance of the f-pawn serves as the basic method of struggle against the wedge. A careful assessment of the position will determine whether the construction of the wedge is favourable or unfavourable. The wedge, of course, allows the gain of space and cramps the opponent, but at the same time limits the dynamic resources and, uo the contrary, increases them for the enemy due to clear prospects of a lively pawn action on the king's flank. It is hardly worthwhile constructing a wedge just to somewhat cramp the opponent. The construction of a wedge is justified only in that case when it is possible to count on retaining the initiative or at least where there is the possibility of preventing the advance of the enemy f-pawn.

zh_before: 板上有异格象。在残局中，即使对手有相当大的 e 子力优势，这通常也能保证平局。另一方面，在中局中，异格象的存在往往会让进攻方更容易取得胜利。通常这取决于兵链的排列。在本局对局中，黑方兵的主要群体延伸到四个格 - f6 - e5d4 - c5（楔子！）。与此同时，他有一个黑格象，它到处都会遇到障碍，其形状是自己的兵。另一件事是对手的象，将火力集中在白格上，这是棋盘上最重要的主线。如果我们加上这样一个事实，即黑方在 f6 上有弱兵，他的王放置不稳，其最后一个掩护 - h7 点 - 暴露于攻击，并且敌方车在王翼区域控制了弱白格，那么很明显，白方已经实现了决定性的优势。
zh_after: 棋盘上形成异格象。残局中，即使一方有明显的子力优势，异格象也常能帮助另一方守和；但在中局，它往往反而有利于进攻方取胜，具体取决于兵链的配置。本局黑方的主要兵群位于f6-e5-d4-c5——仍是那个兵楔！黑格象却处处受己方兵阻挡。白格象则完全不同，它沿重要的白格通道发挥强大作用。加上f6兵薄弱、黑王位置不稳、最后的屏障h7也遭到攻击，白车又控制王翼的白格弱点，可见白方已经取得决定性优势。
en_before: On the board are opposite coloured bishops. In the endgame this often serves to guarantee a draw even when t the opponent has a considerable e material advantage. On the other hand, in the middlegame the presence of opposite coloured bishops quite often makes it easier for the attacking side to achieve victory. Usually this depends on the arrangement of the pawn chain. In the present game, the principal group of Black pawns extends over four squares - f6-e5d4-c5 (the wedge!). Meanwhile, he has a black-squared bishop which comes up against a barrier everywhere, in the shape of its own pawns. Another matter is the opponent's bishop, centering fire on the white squares which are the most important main lines on the board. If we add to this the fact that Black has a weak pawn on f6, his king is insecurely placed, its last cover - the h7 point - exposed to attack, and the enemy rooks dominate the weak white squares in the region of the king's flank, then it becomes clear that White has achieved a decisive advantage.

zh_before: 这是白方对抗老印度防御的一种长期存在的方式，并且最近在实践中变得越来越频繁。众所周知，在与斯梅斯洛夫的回归对局中，鲍特维尼克同样坚持了这样的开局处理。f-兵看似非常温和的举动具有重大的规划意义。它远远超出了简单地努力加强兵中心的主要链接之一——e4兵的限制。白方的计划包括构建楔子以及随后的反击...f5与g4。如果黑方不采取...f5，那么他不仅会被楔子严重挤压，而且白方也有可能通过h4-h5对兵发起危险的兵攻击。所有这些“王牌”都被白方在本局对局中利用了。
zh_after: 这是白方对付古印度防御的一种古老方案，在本书写作时期又越来越常见。鲍特维尼克对斯梅斯洛夫的世界冠军回敬赛中，也采用了这一思路。看似温和的f兵一步，具有深远的计划意义，远不只是巩固中心支柱e4兵。白方准备建立兵楔，再以g4应对...f5反击。若黑方不走...f5，不仅会被兵楔严重压缩，还可能遭到h4-h5发动的危险的兵的攻击。本局白方充分利用了这些有利条件。
en_before: This is a long-standing way of playing against the King's Indian Defence for White, and has recently become more and more frequently met in practice. It is wellknown that in his return match with Smyslov, Botvinnik likewise stuck to this treatment of the opening. The apparently very modest move of the f-pawn has great planning significance. It extends far beyond the limits of a simple striving to reinforce one of the main links of the pawn centre - the e4 pawn. White's plan consists of the construction of a wedge with a subsequent meeting of the counterattack ... f5 with g4. If Black refrains from ... f5, then he will not only turn out to be severely cramped by the wedge, but White will also have the possibility of developing a dangerous pawn attack on the king's flank by h4-h5. All these ""trumps" are exploited by White in the present game.

zh_before: 这一立场雄辩地证明了有关开场斗争的相反观念是如何发生变化的。根据经典原理，主要的开局任务还没有完成：棋子实际上还没有发展，主要是兵已经进步（白方将在前10步中走7步！）。然而，尽管一些开局理论家持不同意见，但开局阶段可以认为已经结束。对手的计划，特别是白方，已经确定，但计划的斗争 - 已经是中局的过程。
zh_after: 这个局面鲜明地说明，开局观念已经发生变化。按经典原则，开局的主要任务尚未完成：棋子几乎都没有出动，主要走的是兵，白方前十步中竟有七步走兵！不过，尽管有些开局理论家不同意，我们仍可认为开局已经结束：双方，尤其是白方的计划已经明确，而计划之间的交锋，已是中局的内容。
en_before: This position eloquently bears witness to how contemporary notions have changed concerning the opening struggle. According to classical principles, the principal opening task has still not been accomplished: the pieces are virtually undeveloped, it is mainly the pawns which have advanced (White's will make 7 moves out of the first 10!). And yet, despite the opinion of some opening theoreticians, the opening stage can be considered over. The plans of the opponents, particularly White, are determined, but the struggle of the plans - is already a process of the middlegame.

zh_after: 从鲁宾斯坦的行动可以看出，他准备先兑掉黑格象，缓解压力，再把王、马、后三枚子力集中保护f6，以应对白方可能投入的三枚攻击子力：f线上的后、车，以及g4马。但他忽略了h6也是白方的攻击目标。更严重的是，他允许白方在f6钉下一兵，而这将对进攻起决定性作用。
en_before: On the basis of Rubinstein's plan of defence, the following ideas come out of his actions: the exchangeC of the black-squared bishops (clearing the atmosphere), the concentration of three defenders on the f6 point - the king, the knight, the queen - against three possible White blows: the queen and rook on the f-file and the knight from the g4 square. And yet with this he does not take into account the weakness of the h6 square, which likewise serves as an object of White's attack. However, allowing the pawn nail on the f-file, which in the end will be hammered in on the f6 square, proves to be a decisive help to this attack.

zh_after: Qe3。至少有五个理由支持这步：保护e2象，解除f3马的牵制；加强对e5的控制；再保护一次d4兵；阻止...Qf4；并让后避开...Na5的攻击。尽管如此，这步动后仍值得批评，因为它没有落实利用中心悬兵长处的计划。白方应走14. Rfd1，准备d5!，再寻求Nf1-e3的运马方案。无论如何，都应让对手始终面临冲兵的威胁，尽量保持中心的紧张状态。
en_before: Qe3 At least five considerations can be advanced in favour of this move: White defends the bishop e2 and thereby unpins the knight f3, he increases the pressure on the central point e5, defends the d4 pawn one more time, prevents the thrust ... Qf4, and finally takes the queen away from the threat of ... Na5. And yet the queen move merits censure, above all because it does not represent a link in the execution of the plan, outlined above, of exploiting the favourable side on the " "hanging centre. It was necessary for White to play 14. Rfd1, with the aim of playing d5! and then try to carry out the manoeuvre Nf1-e3. In any case his task is to keep the opponent under threat of a pawn a advance and thereby increase the tension in the centre as much as possible.

en_before: Usually the phalanx breaks through the front and only then do the pieces rush into the attack. In this game it was the other way around. The attack began with the pieces, but then they had need of the pawn phalanx.

zh_before: 兵侧翼的群众攻击被形象地称为风暴，但它实际上确实有这个名称，因为它是在激烈的斗争中以武力猛烈地发展的。由于易位在两侧，有时双方都会冲入风暴，成功通常属于第一个完成兵护送并开始放松敌人王阵势的人。兵潮也经常发生在同侧易位或完全没有易位。在这种情况下，攻击方需要密切关注自身安全，主动暴露自己的王，不要让对手通过反击使斗争复杂化。
zh_after: 侧翼兵群的猛烈进攻，形象地称为“兵潮”。它来势迅猛、具有强制性，确实名副其实。异向易位时，双方有时会同时发动兵潮，通常是谁先把兵送到对方阵地、破坏敌王的防护，谁就更容易成功。同向易位，甚至尚未易位时，也可以发动兵潮。不过，这时进攻方主动冲起护王兵，必须格外注意自己的王，避免让对手通过反击把局面复杂化。
en_before: The attack of a pawn mass on the flanks is figuratively called a storm, but it does actually warrant this name since it develops impetuously, by force, and in the intense heat of the struggle. With castling on opposite sides, at times both opponents rush into the storm and success usually attends the one who first achieves pawn escort and begins to loosen the position of the enemy king. Not infrequently the pawn storm takes place also upon same-side castling or entirely without castling. In such cases the attacking side needs to watch closely for his own security, in voluntarily exposing his own king, and not allow the opponent to complicate the struggle by means of a counterattack.
en_after: The attack of a pawn mass on the flanks is figuratively called a storm, but it does actually warrant this name since it develops impetuously, by force, and in the intense heat of the struggle. With castling on opposite sides, at times both opponents rush into the storm and success usually attends the one who first achieves pawn escort and begins to loosen the position of the enemy king. Not infrequently the pawn storm takes place also upon same-side castling or entirely without castling. In such cases the attacking side needs to watch closely for his own security, in voluntarily exposing his own king, and not allow the opponent to complicate the struggle by means of a counterattack.

zh_before: 兵潮栏通常由三个兵组成，在f、g、h或a、b、c线上并列前进；；还有一个两兵列。如果对手城堡位置的g或h兵前进，兵潮成功的机会更大。冲锋纵队与这种兵的接触比与兵在其原始格上的接触要早两个时间，因此总体先手的攻击明显加速。
zh_after: 兵潮通常由f、g、h三兵，或a、b、c三兵并列前冲，也可以只由两个兵组成。如果对方易位阵地的g兵或h兵已经冲起，兵潮就更容易奏效：与这些兵接触，比它们仍在原始格时要快两个先手，整个进攻速度也就明显加快。
en_before: The pawn storm column usually consists of three pawns, advancing side by side on the f, g, h or a, b, c files; ; there is also a two-pawn column. The pawn storm has more chances of success if the g or h pawns in the opponent's castled position have advanced. The contact of the storming column with such pawns takes place two tempi earlier than with pawns on their original squares, and as a consequence the general tempo of attack is apparently accelerated.
en_after: The pawn storm column usually consists of three pawns, advancing side by side on the f, g, h or a, b, c files; ; there is also a two-pawn column. The pawn storm has more chances of success if the g or h pawns in the opponent's castled position have advanced. The contact of the storming column with such pawns takes place two tempi earlier than with pawns on their original squares, and as a consequence the general tempo of attack is apparently accelerated.

zh_before: 有必要仔细计算一个兵潮。然而，这绝非易事。在大多数情况下，风暴会带来一定的风险。即使兵纵队达到目的，与对方的兵接触，也必须权衡兵从战区消失后必然展开的棋子战斗的性质。不能忘记的是，兵群前冲在后方造成了各种位置上的弱点，如果风暴没有成功，那么事情可能会出人意料地比开始时更好。让我们举一些例子。
zh_after: 发动兵潮需要仔细计算，而这并不容易，往往必须承担一定风险。即使兵群已抵达目标并与对方兵接触，还要判断兑兵、打开战区之后的子力战斗。兵群前冲也会在己方后方留下弱点；如果进攻未能奏效，最后可能发现局面并不比最初更好。下面看几个例子。
en_before: It is necessary to carefully calculate a pawn storm. However, this is a far from easy task. In the majority of cases a certain amount of risk is involved in the storm. Even when the pawn column achieves the aim and comes into contact with the opponent's pawns, one has to weigh up the character of the piece battle which must develop after the disappearance of pawns from the battle zone. It must not be forgotten that the advance of the pawn group creates s various positional weaknesses in the rear, and if the storm does not succeed then things might surprisingly ou, q o1 1no uin 1 better off than at the start'. Let us give some illustrations.
en_after: It is necessary to carefully calculate a pawn storm. However, this is a far from easy task. In the majority of cases a certain amount of risk is involved in the storm. Even when the pawn column achieves the aim and comes into contact with the opponent's pawns, one has to weigh up the character of the piece battle which must develop after the disappearance of pawns from the battle zone. It must not be forgotten that the advance of the pawn group creates various positional weaknesses in the rear, and if the storm does not succeed then things might surprisingly turn out to be "no better off than at the start". Let us give some illustrations.

zh_before: 在 Vidmar-塔拉什 (纽伦堡 1906) 中，白方在王翼上开始兵潮。其基础是黑方的城堡位置被削弱了...h6，以及他的象在f6上的狭窄位置。他在中路无能为力，这使得侧翼进攻变得安全。
zh_after: 维德马尔对塔拉什一局（纽伦堡，1906年）中，白方开始发动王翼兵潮。依据是黑方走过...h6，易位阵地有所削弱，而且f6象活动受限。黑方在中心无从反击，使白方的侧翼进攻较为安全。
en_before: In Vidmar-Tarrasch (Nurnberg 1906) White begins a pawn storm on the king's flank. The basis for this is the weakening of Black's castled position by the move ... h6 and the cramped position of his bishop on f6. He can do nothing in the centre and this makes the flank attack safe.

zh_before: 风暴结出了果实。黑方王的局面明显恶化，马已被推回g8且无一招，f7和g7点较弱。另一方面，白方的棋子下得非常积极，空位的h线可以毫不费力地占领，并且开始显示出实现位置优势的具体计划，例如Bd2随后是Qf3。
zh_after: 兵潮已经见效。黑王的处境明显恶化，马被赶回g8，无处可去，f7和g7也很薄弱。白方子力却十分活跃，可以轻松占据开放的h线，并已有兑现局面优势的具体计划，例如Bd2后Qf3。
en_before: The storm yields its fruit. The Black king's position has appreciably deteriorated, his knight has been pushed back to g8 and does not have a single move, the f7 and g7 points are weak. White's pieces, on the other hand, are very actively placed, the open h-file can be occupied without difficulty, and also a concrete plan begins to show for the realisation of the positional advantage, for example Bd2 followed by Qf3.

zh_after: 下面再看几盘完整对局。第一局的特点是，白方几乎在开局阶段、黑方尚未易位时，就发动王翼兵潮。除了暴露黑王的位置，还意在阻止黑方短易位：把王放到迎面而来的兵群之前，显然太冒险。
en_before: Let us look at a few games. The peculiarity of the first of these lies in the fact that White begins a pawn storm on the king's flank even before Black has castled, almost in the opening stage, and in the present case, together with a particular aim - to open the position of the king, it has also the object of preventing Black from castling on the king's side. To place the king under frontal attack from the infantry would, on his part, be foolhardy.

zh_before: 相对侧易位是西西里防御这种变体的特征，它预先确定了白方的计划，该计划包括在王翼上执行兵潮。并非没有根据的是，有一种观点认为黑方没有必要急于将其王移至侧翼，并且在许多对局中，他在初步8... Nxd4 9. Qxd4之后执行易位，如果是10. f4，则10... Qa5。不可否认，在这种情况下，白方仍然有兵攻击王的位置置的可能性。
zh_after: 这一西西里防御变化常形成异向易位，白方的计划也因此明确：在王翼发动兵潮。有一种颇有道理的看法，认为黑方不必急于易位，可以先8... Nxd4 9. Qxd4，再易位；若10. f4，则10... Qa5。不过，即使如此，白方仍有用兵进攻黑王的机会。
en_before: The opposite-side castling, characteristic for this variation of the Sicilian Defence, predetermines White's plan, which consists of the carrying out of a pawn storm on the king's flank. Not without foundation there is an opinion that there is no need for Black to hurry with the removal of his king to the flank, and in a number of games he carries out castling after a preliminary 8... Nxd4 9. Qxd4, and if 10. f4, then 10... Qa5. Admittedly, also in this case prospects of a pawn attack on the king's position remain for White.
en_after: The opposite-side castling, characteristic for this variation of the Sicilian Defence, predetermines White's plan, which consists of the carrying out of a pawn storm on the king's flank. Nxd4 9. Qxd4, and if 10. f4, then 10... Qa5. Admittedly, also in this case prospects of a pawn attack on the king's position remain for White.

zh_before: 一幅暴风雨的彩色图画。黑方的动员能力非常出色，他的马被放置在棋盘中央的弱格上，他的两个车都朝着中心的方向运作，其中一个位于空旷的c线上，直接通向敌人的避难所王。然而，白方也在用他的三兵潮组进攻，这是他唯一但非常重要的位置优势。接下来的动作中，他的兵与黑方王的防御掩护接触，进行必要的交锋，然后白方的棋子军队，首先是他的后和车，开始非常有力地对抗在线上造成的突破口。
zh_after: 这是兵潮进攻的一幅生动画面。黑方出子充分，马占据中心弱格，双车都作用于中心，其中一车还占据直接通向白王的开放c线。白方的优势则在于三兵组成的进攻群，虽然只有这一点，却十分重要。接下来，白兵将与黑王的护卫兵接触，进行必要的兑换，再由后、车等子力沿打开的线路强力进攻。
en_before: A colourful picture of a storm. Black is excellently mobilised, his knight is placed in the centre of the board on a weak square, both his rooks operate in the direction of the centre, one of them is located on the open c-file which leads straight to the haven of the enemy king. However, White is also attacking with his three-pawn storm-group, and this is his only, but very important, positional plus. With the next moves, his pawns enter into contact with the Black king's defensive cover, bring about necessary exchanges, and then White's piece army, in the first instance his queen and rook, begin to operate very powerfully against the breach which has been created on the file.

zh_before: 至此，我们总结了将兵作为攻击力量的主题。仍然需要注意的是，尽管本章和本书其他部分提供了大量材料，但关于兵积极作用的问题决不能被认为是详尽无遗的。我们在最后几章中再次遇到它，特别是在工作的第二部分中，我们特别考虑了兵的组合作用。
zh_after: 本章关于兵作为进攻力量的讨论到此结束。虽然本章及其他章节提供了许多例子，但兵的积极作用远未讨论完。后面的章节，尤其是本书第二部分，还会再次涉及这一问题，并专门讨论兵在战术组合中的作用。

zh_before: 在引言中我们已经指出了中局和残局阶段之间存在高度显着的差异。进入残局的过渡在很大程度上改变了整个主题斗争，这也意味着它的计划和操作方法。值得一提的是，在残局中，弱项和强项的评价发生了变化，开放线的重要性、理论和技术的作用也增加了，对运用兵的特殊要求也出现了。
zh_after: 导言中已经指出，中局与残局有着十分重要的区别。转入残局后，斗争的主题、计划和行动方法都会发生很大变化。尤其需要注意的是，强点、弱点以及开放线的意义都会随之改变，理论知识和技术的重要性上升，运用兵也有了特殊要求。
en_before: In the introduction we have already pointed out the presence of a highly significant difference e between the middlegame and endgame stages. The transition into the endgame to a considerable extent changes both the whole thematic struggle, which means also the planning of it, and methods of operation. It is very important to mention that in t the endgame the evaluation of weak and strong points is changed and also the significance of open lines, the role of theory and technique increases, and particular requirements for handling pawns arise.

zh_before: 与此相关，不可避免地会出现一个问题：在博弈的中央阶段，在多大程度上有必要以将斗争转移到残局的可能性为指导？你会看到国际象棋对局呈现为一个整体，尽管中局和残局的位置要求存在显着差异，但永远不应该忘记的是，在许多情况下，即使是中局中最激烈和最紧张的斗争也会在残局深处完成。
zh_after: 由此自然产生一个问题：在中局阶段，应当在多大程度上考虑将来转入残局的可能性？一盘棋毕竟是一个整体。尽管中局和残局对局面的要求差别很大，我们仍须记住，许多激烈而紧张的中局斗争，要到残局深处才能分出胜负。
en_before: In this connection the question inevitably arises: to what extent in the central stage of the game is it necessary to be guided by considerations coming out of the possibility of transferring the struggle to the endgame? You see the game of chess presents itself as a single whole and, despite the significant difference in the positional requirements of the middlegame and endgame, never should it be forgotten that in many cases even the most sharp and tense struggle in the middlegame receives its completion deep in the endgame.
en_after: In this connection the question inevitably arises: to what extent in the central stage of the game is it necessary to be guided by considerations coming out of the possibility of transferring the struggle to the endgame? zh_before: 可以笼统地回答这个问题，即考虑到未来残局的可能性，不应过分夸大其作用，而更应决定性地重视解决中局乃至某些开局的创造性问题。
zh_after: 一般说来，应当考虑未来可能出现的残局，但不能夸大这一因素的作用，更不能让它决定中局、甚至某些开局阶段的构思。
en_before: It is possible to reply to this question in a general way, that, taking into account the possibility of the future endgame, one should not exaggerate its role and so much the more attach decisive importance to the solving of the creative problems of the middlegame and even some openings.
en_after: It is possible to reply to this question in a general way, that, taking into account the possibility of the future endgame, one should not exaggerate its role and so much the more attach decisive importance to the solving of the creative problems of the middlegame and even some openings.

zh_before: 可以说，没有必要徒劳地恶化兵阵型，因为这可能会对残局产生不利的影响。但是，如果中局的具体行动计划需要创建落后的、双重的、孤立的甚至是兵的阵型，那么就有必要通过放弃仅与残局相关的抽象考虑来实现这一点。
zh_after: 例如，不应无端破坏自己的兵形，因为这可能在残局中带来不利影响。但若中局的具体行动计划要求承担落后兵、叠兵、孤兵等兵形弱点，就应当接受，抛开那些仅适用于残局的抽象顾虑。
en_before: Let us say there is no need to worsen one's pawn formation in vain, since this might have an unfavourable effect in the endgame. But if a concrete plan of action, intended in the middlegame, requires the creation of backward, doubled, isolated and even a formation of pawns, then it is necessary to go in for this by discarding abstract considerations, relevent only to the endgame.

zh_before: 例如，众所周知，拉斯克执白采用西班牙开局兑换变例（1. e4. e5 2. Nf3. Nc6 3. Bb5. a6 4. Bxc6），计划在4... dxc6之后利用残局中王翼多兵的优势。他在对雅诺夫斯基和塔拉什的对抗赛中成功执行了这一计划。不过，在1896年纽伦堡国际大赛上，他用同一变例甚至在进入残局之前就击败了塔拉什。更鲜明的例子是1914年彼得堡的拉斯克对卡帕布兰卡一局。卡帕布兰卡熟悉拉斯克转入残局的计划，于是在兑换变例中封锁e兵，准备用e线双车并由b7象支援来攻击它。战斗仍在中局展开，拉斯克毫不犹豫地冲起f5，使e4兵成为落后弱兵。在斗争的决定性时刻，他又弃掉这个兵，让马侵入第六横线、双车叠入第七横线，彻底击溃了这位强劲的对手。拉斯克在构思进攻时，对自己的前景作出了细致而深入的判断，完全没有受可能转入残局这一因素的束缚。

en_before: It is well-known, for example, that Lasker,by（ choosing the exchange variation of the Spanish Game as White (1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Bxc6), was planning, after 4... dxc6, to exploit the extra pawn on the king's flank in the endgame. He carried out this plan with success in match games against Janowski i and Tarrasch. This did not prevent Lasker, in the international tourmnament at Nirnberg 1896, finishing off Tarrasch in the same variation even before the transfer of the game into an ending. A still more striking example was the game Lasker-Capablanca (Petersburg 1914). Capablanca, familiar with Lasker's planned line to the endgame, in the exchange variation, blockaded the e-pawn and planned an attack on it with the rooks on the open e-file together with support from the bishop on b7. The struggle developed in the middlegame, in which Lasker did not stop at the advance f5, as a result of which the e4 pawn became backward and weak. At the decisive moment of the struggle he sacrificed this pawn, to invade with the knight on the sixth rank and the rooks on the seventh, and literally smashed his dangerous opponent. In conceiving the idea of attack, Lasker assessed his prospects finely and deeply and disregarded considerations about a possible endgame.

zh_before: 简而言之，如果能够将中局和残局的位置要求结合起来，那就更好了。但如果它们发生冲突，则必须优先考虑中局的要求。
zh_after: 如果能兼顾中局和残局的要求，自然最好；若两者发生冲突，则应优先满足中局的需要。
en_before: In short, if it is possible to combine the positional requirements of the middlegame and endgame - so much the better. But if they clash, then preference must be given to the requirements of the middlegame.
en_after: In short, if it is possible to combine the positional requirements of the middlegame and endgame - so much the better. But if they clash, then preference must be given to the requirements of the middlegame.

zh_before: 当双方只有后和车参与斗争时（显然，除了兵），这些问题以特别尖锐的方式出现。这种中局局面的特点是，交换棋子之一会导致残局 - 后或车。这里，残局局势的计算成为最重要的评估因素之一。
zh_after: 当双方除兵以外，只剩后和车参加斗争时，这个问题尤其突出。这类中局的特点是，只需兑掉一对棋子，就会转入后残局或车残局。因此，对可能出现的残局作出判断，便成为评价当前局面的重要依据之一。
en_before: These questions arise in a particularly sharp fashion in positions where only queens and rooks on each side take part in the struggle (obviously, besides the pawns). The feature of this sort of middlegame position consists of the fact that the exchange of one of the pieces leads to an endgame - a queen or a rook. Here, calculation of the endgame situation becomes one of the most important factors for assessment.

zh_before: 在国际象棋文献中，有人认为有必要将具有重子材料的局面视为残局。这是一个深刻的错误。
zh_after: 有些国际象棋著作主张，应把只剩重子的局面当作残局处理。这是根本性的错误。
en_before: In chess literature the opinion is expressed that it is necessary to treat positions with heavy piece material as an endgame. This is a profound error.
en_after: In chess literature the opinion is expressed that it is necessary to treat positions with heavy piece material as an endgame. This is a profound error.

zh_before: 对局最后阶段的一个特点是王完全有权参与斗争。残局中的王是主动的棋子，常常决定战斗的结果。与此同时，在后和车在场的情况下，王不得不在兵的掩护下寻求庇护，并忘记了这一事实，因为错误的观念认为斗争已经进入了最后阶段，可能会结束并且实际上确实以一种非常悲伤的方式结束。
zh_after: 残局的一个典型特点，是王能够充分参加战斗，成为活跃的棋子，并常常决定胜负。但当双方仍有后和车时，王必须躲在兵的掩护之下。如果误以为已经进入残局，忘记了这一点，就很可能付出惨重的代价；实战中这样的例子并不少见。
en_before: A characteristic feature of the concluding stage of the game is the full right of the king to take part in the struggle. The king in the endgame is an active piece, which frequently decides the outcome of the battle. Meanwhile, in the presence of the queen and rook, the king is obliged to seek shelter behind pawn cover, and forgetting this truth prompted by the mistaken notion that the struggle has proceeded to the endgame, might end and actually does end in a very sad way.

zh_before: 同时，王必须做好准备，在兑后之后立即投入战斗，并出现车结局。另一方面，在交换其中一个重子导致残局阶段的位置中，必须高度关注兵阵型，以确保其在最后阶段尽可能舒适。通兵的存在具有特别重要的意义。这种优势常常具有决定性的特征。你看，有必要阻止通兵的前进，在目前的情况下，封锁棋子的作用不适合王，而在后或车的封锁上浪费后或车的能量意味着在剩下的时间里让对手获得武力优势。奋斗。
zh_after: 与此同时，王又必须随时准备在兑后转入车残局后立即参战。另一方面，既然兑掉一对重子就可能进入残局，便应特别注意兵形，尽量使它适合残局。通路兵在这里尤为重要，往往能成为决定性的优势。对手必须阻止它前进，但在当前局面中，王不宜承担封锁任务；若用后或车封锁兵，又会牵制这枚重子的力量，让对手在其他战场形成兵力优势。

On the other hand, in positions where an exchange of one of the heavy pieces leads to the endgame phase, great attention has to be paid to the pawn formation, to see that it is as comfortable as possible for the end-stage. The presence of passed pawns is of particular significance. Often this advantage acquires a decisive character. You see it is necessary to bring to a halt the advance of a passed pawn, in the present case the role of a blockading piece is not appropriate for the king, while to waste the energy of a queen or rook on the blockade of a pawn means conceding an advantage in force to the opponent for the rest of the struggle.

zh_before: 这一举动证明了皮尔斯伯里没有试图足够深入地了解所出现的情况。I通过将车从横线后面移除，他注定了后成为通兵守望者的角色。N同时，在即将到来的斗争中，后的能量需要为后提供能量。完成另一项任务。因此，毫不奇怪，很快黑方不仅无力实现自己的优势，而且真正的失败威胁笼罩着他。车举动还有另一个阴暗面，它使黑方王的位置恶化，车现在与黑方王失去联系。皮尔斯伯里在做出侵略性的t冲刺时，显然是指望激活已通过的e-兵，并通过威胁推进来避免或在一定程度上削弱敌人的攻击力通兵。然而，很快就发现这个计划是错误的，目前情况下通过的a-兵比e-兵更先进、更危险。皮尔斯伯里的想法被证明不够具体，他无法以必要的清晰度预见到实现计划目标的方法。
zh_after: 这步说明皮尔斯伯里没有深入理解局面。他把车调离底线，迫使后留下来看守通路兵；但接下来的斗争恰恰需要后去完成另一项任务。因此，黑方很快不仅无法兑现优势，反而面临输棋的危险。这步动车还削弱了黑王的安全，因为车已无法照应王。皮尔斯伯里积极出击，显然是想活跃自己的e通路兵，用冲兵威胁牵制对方的通路兵。然而，实战很快证明这个计划有误：当前局面中，a通路兵走得更远，也比e通路兵更危险。皮尔斯伯里的构想不够具体，没有清楚看出实现目标的途径。
en_before: This move bears witness to the fact that Pillsbury did not try to understand sufficiently deeply the situation which has arisen.I By removing g the rook from the back rank, he dooms the queen to the role of watchman for the passed pawn.N Meanwhile, in the forthcoming struggle, the energy of the queen is needed for the fulfilment of another task. It is therefore no surprise that soon Black not only proves to be powerless to realise his advantage but also a real threat of defeat hangs over him. The rook move also has another shady side it worsens the position of the Black king, with which the rook now loses contact. In making his aggressive t thrust, Pillsbury obviously counted on enlivening the passed e-pawn and, by threatening to advance it, to avert or to some extent weaken the offensive power of the enemypassed pawn. However, very soon it becomes clear that this plan is mistaken and that the passed a-pawn in the present situation is more advanced and dangerous than the e-pawn. Pillsbury's idea proves to be insufficiently concrete, he cannot foresee, with necessary distinctness, a way of leading to the achievement of the planned objective.
en_after: This move bears witness to the fact that Pillsbury did not try to understand sufficiently deeply the situation which has arisen.I By removing g the rook from the back rank, he dooms the queen to the role of watchman for the passed pawn.N Meanwhile, in the forthcoming struggle, the energy of the queen is needed for the fulfilment of another task. It is therefore no surprise that soon Black not only proves to be powerless to realise his advantage but also a real threat of defeat hangs over him. The rook move also has another shady side it worsens the position of the Black king, with which the rook now loses contact. In making his aggressive t thrust, Pillsbury obviously counted on enlivening the passed e-pawn and, by threatening to advance it, to avert or to some extent weaken the offensive power of the enemypassed pawn. However, very soon it becomes clear that this plan is mistaken and that the passed a-pawn in the present situation is more advanced and dangerous than the e-pawn. Pillsbury's idea proves to be insufficiently concrete, he cannot foresee, with necessary distinctness, a way of leading to the achievement of the planned objective.

zh_before: 白方有一个通兵，实际上也是从后面防守的。在车和后结局中，这保证了他无可争议的位置优势。然而，由于后和车在棋盘上，许多其他因素会影响局面的评估。例如，在当前情况下，需要注意第二个横线上黑方车的强势位置，它比白方车处于更活跃的位置。鉴于“通风口”h6 的存在，王的位置置的比较同样证明对黑方有利。他在中心有一个强大的移动兵。白方在f2上有弱点。在这种情况下，白方 a4 上的通兵可能会从优势转变为劣势，这一点已被立即发生的事件所证实。
zh_after: 白方有一个从后方得到保护的通路兵。在车残局或后残局中，这能保证他拥有明确的局面优势。但双方同时还有后和车时，评价局面必须考虑其他因素。这里黑车在第二横线上十分活跃，远胜白车；比较双方王的位置，黑方因h6提供了逃生格，同样占优。此外，黑方有一个强大而灵活的中心兵，白方的f2则是弱点。在这种情况下，a4通路兵可能由优势变成负担，接下来的实战便证实了这一点。
en_before: White has a passed pawn, indeed one which is furthermore defended from behind. In the rook and queen endings this guarantees him an indisputable positional advantage. However, with queen and rook on the board, a number of other factors influence the assessment of the position. In the present case, for example, it is necessary to pay attention to the strong position of the Black rook on the second rank, where it is far actively placed than the more White rook. A comparison of the positions of the kings likewise proves to be in Black's favour in view of the presence of the "vent" h6. He has a strong mobile pawn in the centre. White has a weak point on f2. In such a situation White's passed pawn on a4 might be converted from a strength into a weakness, and this is confirmed by the immediate course of events.

zh_before: 尽管力量平等且立场相对简单，白方有理由认为他的立场更可取。他的兵放置得更紧凑，黑c5兵是孤立的，是一个压力对象。尽管如此，白方获胜的机会必须被认为是微乎其微的。白方没有办法增加对c5兵的攻击，棋盘上的操作力量非常有限，d3兵无法从d4格开始帮助其棋子，在那里它可能会与d4格接触。c5兵，被牢牢封锁。为了激活他的王而强制采用车结局对白方有利，但实现这一点相当困难。然而，一般来说，他的王的位置比敌人王差，而敌人王确实被兵覆盖。然而主动权无疑是白方的手。黑方处于被动防御状态，必须密切关注，以防敌人试图在某处表现出活动。
zh_after: 虽然双方子力相等，局面也相对简单，白方仍有理由认为自己稍好：他的兵形更紧凑，黑方的c5孤兵则是施压目标。不过，白方的胜机很小。棋盘上的子力有限，无法再加强对c5兵的攻击；d3兵也帮不上忙，因为能与c5兵接触的d4格已被牢牢封锁。白方若能转入车残局、活跃自己的王，自然有利，但这很难做到。就当前局面而言，白王的位置反倒不及受到兵可靠掩护的黑王。不过，主动权仍掌握在白方手中。黑方只能被动防守，时刻提防白方在其他区域采取行动。
en_before: Despite the equality of forces and relative simplicity of the position, White has a basis for considering his position preferable. His pawns are more compactly placed, the Black c5 pawn is isolated and is an object for pressure. Nevertheless, White's chances of victory must be regarded as being minimal. There is no way for White to increase t the a attack on the c5 pawn, t the number of operating forces on the board is very limited, the d3 pawn cannot go to the help of its pieces since the d4 square, where it might come into contact with the c5 pawn, is firmly blockaded. It is to White's advantage to force a rook ending in order to activate his king, but it is quite difficult to achieve this. However, generally speaking, his king is worse placed than the enemy king, which is reliably covered with pawns. And yet the initiative is undoubtedly White's hands. Black is chained to passive defence and must watch closely in case the enemy attempts to display activity somewhere.

zh_before: 白方的计划应该包括哪些内容？在第一阶段，他的主要任务必须是将敌人后从中央d5位置赶走，并用他的后占领c4格，在那里它将更加积极地放置。在此基础上，白方必须准备好交换后，从而将斗争转移到车残局。在这方面，他必须为这样的结局创造尽可能有利的条件。
zh_after: 白方应制定怎样的计划？第一阶段的主要任务，是把黑后赶离中心的d5据点，再让自己的后占据c4，获得更大的活性。同时，白方要准备兑后转入车残局，并为此尽可能创造有利条件。
en_before: What should White's plan consist of? At the first stage his main task must be to drive away the enemy queen from the central d5 position and occupy the c4 square with his queen, where it will be far more actively placed. Upon this, White must be ready to exchange queens and thus to transfer the struggle into a rook endgame. In this connection he must create as favourable conditions as possible for such an endgame.
en_after: What should White's plan consist of? At the first stage his main task must be to drive away the enemy queen from the central d5 position and occupy the c4 square with his queen, where it will be far more actively placed. Upon this, White must be ready to exchange queens and thus to transfer the struggle into a rook endgame. In this connection he must create as favourable conditions as possible for such an endgame.

zh_before: 我们更详细地了解白方未来的运营。最重要的是，他必须将他的王尽可能靠近中心移动，比如说 f2 格，而在车残局中，他将准备前进 e3，然后是 d4，并将车放在 c线上。这将导致 c5 兵获胜，当然前提是对手本人没有成功地将他的王带到中心。
zh_after: 具体来说，首先应让王尽量靠近中心，例如走到f2。进入车残局后，可让车占据c线，再准备冲起e3和d4。如果黑王来不及赶到中心，就能吃掉c5兵。

zh_before: 我们还有待一点总结。这相当于：我们所看到的类型的重子的斗争是一个中间对局的过程，并且尝试将王作为主动的棋子包含在这场斗争中与在任何中间对局中发生时一样危险；除此之外，在重子的斗争中，一些残局因素（通兵的作用等）的重要性增加，而诸如兵潮、各种兵中间阵型等操作则在很大程度上失去了效力；重子的斗争通常以极大的尖锐性为特征，因为它包含尽可能多的活动范围，并且可以快速转移到棋盘的任何部分。
zh_after: 最后归纳一下：本章所讨论的重子斗争属于中局，贸然让王积极参战，与其他中局一样危险。不过，在这类局面中，一些残局因素，如通路兵的作用，会更加重要；而兵潮、中心各种兵阵等手段的效果，反而会大幅降低。重子的活动范围很广，能够迅速把战斗转移到棋盘的任何区域，因此这类斗争通常十分尖锐。
en_before: It remains for us to sum up a little. This amounts to the following: the struggle of heavy pieces of the type we have looked at is a process of the middlegame, and an attempt to include the king as an active piece in this struggle is just as risky as when it occurs in any middlegame; in addition to this, in the struggle of heavy pieces, several endgame factors (the role of the passed pawn etc.) increase in significance, while such operations as a pawn storm, various pawn formations in the centre and so on, on the other hand lose their effectiveness to a large extent; the struggle of heavy pieces is usually distinguished by great sharpness, in so far as it contains as much range of activity as is possible, and can quickly shift to any part of the board.

zh_before: 调动是一个与上世纪末出现在国际象棋艺术视野中的特定现象有关的概念，主要是由英国和德国国际象棋流派的一些代表提倡教条主义引起的。
zh_after: “调动”这一概念，与上世纪末棋坛出现的一种现象有关。当时，英国和德国学派的一些代表人物提倡教条化的下法，促成了这种现象。
en_before: Manoeuvering is a concept that arose in connection with a definite phenomenon on the horizons of chess art which appeared at the end of the last century and was provoked mainly by the advocating of dogmatism by a number of representatives of the English and German chess schools.
en_after: Manoeuvering is a concept that arose in connection with a definite phenomenon on the horizons of chess art which appeared at the end of the last century and was provoked mainly by the advocating of dogmatism by a number of representatives of the English and German chess schools.

zh_before: 在许多事件中，这些大师开始推荐一种等待策略。其中一位合伙人按照这一建议，等到他的对手最终在他的阵营中制造了一个真正的弱点或犯了一些其他类型的错误。也有可能，双方都学会了耐心，开始运子独自站在通讯后方，遵循极其谨慎的政策，尽量不给对方哪怕是最轻微的攻击机会。
zh_after: 这些大师在不少情况下倡导等待战术：一方耐心等待，直到对手在阵地中留下真正的弱点，或犯下其他错误。有时双方都十分耐心，各自在后方调动子力，采取极端谨慎的方针，力求不给对手哪怕最微小的进攻机会。
en_before: In a number of events, with these masters came to be recommended a form of waiting tactics. One of the partners, following this recommendation, waited until his opponent finally created a real weakness in his camp or made some other sort of mistake. It would also happen that both partners, having learned to be patient, began to manoeuvre by themselves in the rear of communications, following a policy of extreme caution and trying not to give each other even if only the slightest chance of attack.

zh_before: 在调动中，人们可以感知到几个层次。除了等待、漫无目的调动，还有强迫、计划调动。当实现预期目标需要延长棋子和兵运子时，就会发生这种情况。调动的这个方面特别常见于闭合 t 类型的位置，即具有相互锁定的兵链。
zh_after: 调动也有不同类型。除消极等待、缺乏目的的调动外，还有局面所迫、按计划进行的调动：要实现既定目标，必须经过长时间的子力和兵的调动。这种情况尤其常见于双方兵链相互锁住的封闭局面。
en_before: In manoeuvering one can perceive several gradations. Besides waiting, aimless manoeuvring, there is also forcing, planning manoeuvring. This takes place in those cases where the achievement of the intended aim requires prolonged piece and pawn manoeuvres. This aspect of manoeuvering is seen particularly often in positions of a closed t type, that is with mutually locked pawn chains.

zh_before: 拉斯克给出了后撤退的理由：“黑方的位置很局促，但没有任何组合可以获胜。因此，有必要首先尝试通过新的攻击来瓦解黑方的棋子，然后再回到预定的进攻计划。”
zh_after: 拉斯克解释这次退后的理由：“黑方局面拥挤，但看不出能够取胜的战术组合。因此必须先制造新的威胁，打乱黑方子力的配置，再回到原定的进攻计划。”
en_before: Lasker gave his reasons for the retreat of the queen: "Black's position is cramped, but there are no combinations leading to a win to be seen. Therefore it is necessary to first try to disorganise Black's pieces by means of new attacks and then later return to the intended plan of attack."
en_after: Lasker gave his reasons for the retreat of the queen: "Black's position is cramped, but there are no combinations leading to a win to be seen. Therefore it is necessary to first try to disorganise Black's pieces by means of new attacks and then later return to the intended plan of attack."

zh_before: 拉斯克打算进行哪些“新攻击”？黑方 d6 兵较弱，仅由马防守；可能他打算将目光精确地指向此处，但对 d6 的攻击完全被黑方对 e4 兵的攻击所抵消。
zh_after: 拉斯克准备制造什么“新的威胁”？黑方的d6兵较弱，只由马保护，他或许正瞄准这个目标。不过，白方对d6兵的攻击，可以被黑方对e4兵的反攻完全抵消。
en_before: What are the "new attacks" that Lasker intends? Black has a weak d6 pawn, defended only by the knight; possibly he intends to direct his gaze precisely here, but the attack on d6 is fully counterbalanced by Black's attack on the e4 pawn.
en_after: What are the "new attacks" that Lasker intends? Black has a weak d6 pawn, defended only by the knight; possibly he intends to direct his gaze precisely here, but the attack on d6 is fully counterbalanced by Black's attack on the e4 pawn.

zh_after: 拉斯克开始新一轮调动，长远目标是牵走部分防守王翼的黑子。他把一车、双马留在王翼待命，另一车与后则转而在中心活动。

en_before: In short, the advantage is on White's side, but to convert it into something real proves to be a complicated and difficult task. zh_before: 以齐果林和阿廖欣的经典国际象棋作品为例，我们能够说服自己，调动可以隐藏深刻的目的和思想。然而，要将调动单调的过程转化为灿烂的思想恩赐，需要将顽强的奋斗精神、创造性的灵感和棋艺融为一体。
zh_after: 齐果林与阿廖欣的经典对局说明，调动可以蕴含深刻的目标和构想。不过，要让看似单调的调动展现丰富的内容，必须把顽强的斗志、创造力与高超的棋艺结合起来。
en_before: On the examples of classic chess works of Chigorin and Alekhine, we are able to convince ourselves that manoeuvring can conceal profound aims and ideas. However, in order to transform the monotonous process of manoeuvring into a brilliant boon of ideas, it is necessary to combine, in one go, indomitable spirit of struggle, creative inspiration and chess mastery.
en_after: On the examples of classic chess works of Chigorin and Alekhine, we are able to convince ourselves that manoeuvring can conceal profound aims and ideas. zh_before: 尽管白方在1895年哈斯廷斯黑方本-阿尔宾的对局中额外兵，但他无法取得任何成果——阵地的构建排除了突破的可能性。黑方 b6 兵的潜在弱点无法被认识到。董事会上没有开放线，双方的重子注定不活跃。然而，拥有额外的兵，黑方本并不想满足于平局。结果，出现了调动的许多走法过程，其中白方只是等待黑方是否会偶然放松对b6兵的注意力。黑方同样无能为力，必须运子。b6 兵的防御并不存在任何特别的困难。让我们看看事件是如何发展的。
zh_after: 1895年哈斯廷斯锦标赛，布莱克本对阿尔宾一局，白方虽然多一兵，却无法取得进展。兵形封闭，没有突破的可能，b6兵潜在的弱点也无法利用。棋盘上没有开放线，双方重子都难以发挥作用。但布莱克本不愿带着多一兵的优势接受和棋，于是开始漫长的调动，等待黑方偶然疏忽b6兵的防守。黑方也无事可做，只能跟着调动；保护b6兵并不困难。下面看看实战的发展。
en_before: Despite White's extra pawn in the game Blackburne-Albin from Hastings 1895, he cannot achieve anything - the construction of the position excludes the possibility of a breakthrough. The potential weakness of the Black b6 pawn cannot be realised. There are no open files on the board, and the heavy pieces of both partners are doomed to inactivity. However, having an extra pawn, Blackburne did not want to content himself with a draw. As a result, there arises the process of many moves of manoeuvring, in which White only waits to see if Black will by chance relax his attention to the b6 pawn. Black likewise cannot do anything and is obliged to manoeuvre. The defence of the b6 pawn does not present any particular difficulty. Let us see how events developed.

zh_before: 白方是被迫下最后一步的吗？当然不是。可以玩 6. d4. exd4 7. Qxd4. Qxd4 8. Nxd4，并且该位置将假定为空字符。然而，早期交换后并不符合所有人的口味。但最主要的是，白方预计在不久的将来执行d3-d4或f2-f4前进，打开中心，但没有考虑到对手会阻止该计划的执行，之后他必须运子直到对局结束。
zh_after: 白方刚才这步是被迫的吗？当然不是。6. d4 exd4 7. Qxd4 Qxd4 8. Nxd4可以形成开放局面，只是并非人人都愿意早早兑后。更重要的是，白方打算稍后再以d3-d4或f2-f4打开中心，却没有料到对手会阻止这个计划，使他不得不一直调动到对局结束。
en_before: Was White forced into his last move? Of course not. It was possible to play 6. d4 exd4 7. Qxd4 Qxd4 8. Nxd4, and the position would assume an open character. However, an early exchange of queens is not to everyone's taste. But the main thing is this, that White reckons on carrying out, in the near future, the advance d3-d4 or f2-f4, opening the centre, but does not take into account that the opponent will prevent the execution of this plan, after which he has to manoeuvre until the end of the game.

zh_before: 充满主动权和进取心的国际象棋斗争呈现出截然不同的特征。
zh_after: 积极进取、争夺主动权的对局，则呈现出完全不同的面貌。
en_before: The chess struggle, which is full of initiative and enterprising play, assumes quite a different character.
en_after: The chess struggle, which is full of initiative and enterprising play, assumes quite a different character.

zh_before: 我们已经在本书中多次使用了术语“主动权”。拉丁词“initium”1 的意思是主动权的原理。生活中的主动权 - 这是人类工作任何领域活动的展示。主动权是在个人或集体思想的坚定努力中诞生、变得明显并发展起来的。在国际象棋斗争中，主动权同样表现为一种坚决的活动，旨在对对手产生直接威胁，限制他的位置，限制他的力量的机动性和总体可能性。
zh_after: 本书已经多次使用“主动权”这个词。它的词源可追溯到拉丁语initium，意为“开始”。生活中的主动精神，体现在各个领域积极采取行动，并在坚定落实个人或集体构想的过程中产生、表现和发展。在国际象棋中，争取主动权同样意味着果断行动：向对手制造直接威胁，压缩其阵地，限制其子力活动和可用的选择。
en_before: We have already used the term "initiative" time and again in the pages of this book. The Latin word "initium"1 means the principle of initiative. Initiative in life - this is a display of activity in any area of man's work. The initiative is born, becomes apparent and is developed out of a resolute striving for individual or collective thoughts. In the chess struggle the initiative likewise presents itself as a resolute activity, directed towards the creation of immediate threats to the opponent, to the constraint of his position, to the restriction of the mobility of his forces s and his possibilities in general.
en_after: We have already used the term "initiative" time and again in the pages of this book. The Latin word "initium"1 means the principle of initiative. Initiative in life - this is a display of activity in any area of man's work. The initiative is born, becomes apparent and is developed out of a resolute striving for individual or collective thoughts. In the chess struggle the initiative likewise presents itself as a resolute activity, directed towards the creation of immediate threats to the opponent, to the constraint of his position, to the restriction of the mobility of his forces s and his possibilities in general.

zh_before: 在国际象棋对局中，对手之一经常持有主动权，但有时主动权会碰到对手主动权，特别是在对侧进行攻击时。主动权通常会具有先手的稀有特征：它要么耗尽，要么被对方拦截。
zh_after: 一盘棋中，通常由一方掌握主动权；但也可能双方各有主动行动，尤其是在两翼分别进攻时。主动权往往是暂时的：它可能逐渐消失，也可能被对手夺走。
en_before: More often than not in the chess game, one of the opponents holds the initiative, but there will be occasions when the initiative runs across a counter-initiative, particularly when attacks are conducted on opposite flanks. The initiative will quite often bear a temporary character: it either runs dry or is intercepted by the opposing side.
en_after: More often than not in the chess game, one of the opponents holds the initiative, but there will be occasions when the initiative runs across a counter-initiative, particularly when attacks are conducted on opposite flanks. The initiative will quite often bear a temporary character: it either runs dry or is intercepted by the opposing side.

zh_before: 从规模上来看，主动权的表现形式可以分为几类。主动权可以是小、坚固、耐用、危险、强大等。有时据说主动权发展成一种攻击。这是不准确的。攻击就代表进攻。主动权同样经常参与威胁和攻击。但如果攻击始终是主动权，则主动权无法在所有情况下都被识别为攻击。例如，在阿廖欣-耶茨对局中，白方持有主动权40步——调动的整个过程——但他只在对局结束时获得一次攻击，在g5步之后，当他开始攻击f6和h7时兵并创建了将杀威胁。所以说主动权变成攻击，大致相当于说大胆变成勇敢，怯懦变成胆怯，笑变成吼等等。
zh_after: 主动权可以有不同的程度和性质：轻微、稳固、持久、危险或强大，等等。人们有时说“主动权转化为进攻”，我们认为这并不准确。进攻是一种主动行动，主动权也常表现为威胁和攻势。但有进攻就有主动权，并不意味着所有主动权都等同于进攻。例如阿廖欣对耶茨一局，白方在整个40步的调动过程中都掌握主动权，直到最后冲起g5，开始攻击f6、h7兵并制造将杀威胁时，才真正发动进攻。所以，把两者说成彼此转化的关系，就如同说大胆变成勇敢、怯懦变成胆怯、笑声变成大笑一样，并不严密。
en_before: From the point of view of scale, manifestation of the initiative can be divided into several categories. The initiative can be small, firm, durable, dangerous, s strong etc. Sometimes it is said that the initiative develops into an attack. This is an inaccuracy. An attack represents an offensive. The initiative likewise often attends threats and offensives. But if an attack is always an initiative, then an initiative cannot in all cases be identified with an attack. For example, in the game Alekhine- Yates, White held the initiative for 40 moves - the whole process of manoeuvring - but he only obtained an attack at the end of the game, after the move g5, when he began an assault on the f6 and h7 pawns and created mating threats. Therefore to say that the initiative turns into an attack is roughly the same as talking about the change of boldness into bravery, cowardice into timidity, a laugh into a roar, etc.
en_after: From the point of view of scale, manifestation of the initiative can be divided into several categories. The initiative can be small, firm, durable, dangerous, s strong etc. Sometimes it is said that the initiative develops into an attack. This is an inaccuracy. An attack represents an offensive. The initiative likewise often attends threats and offensives. But if an attack is always an initiative, then an initiative cannot in all cases be identified with an attack. For example, in the game Alekhine- Yates, White held the initiative for 40 moves - the whole process of manoeuvring - but he only obtained an attack at the end of the game, after the move g5, when he began an assault on the f6 and h7 pawns and created mating threats. Therefore to say that the initiative turns into an attack is roughly the same as talking about the change of boldness into bravery, cowardice into timidity, a laugh into a roar, etc.

zh_before: 在对局的开局中，由于第一步的权利，白方持有一个小主动权（比方说，在1. d4之后，黑方被剥夺了回复1... e5）。如果黑方在开局中成功地抵消了哪怕如此轻微的主动权，那么通常会认为他已经扳平了对局，尽管在目前的情况下，“扳平”一词带有特别的条件特征。
zh_after: 开局时，白方凭借先行之利，拥有轻微的主动权。例如1. d4之后，黑方便不能随意应以1... e5。若黑方能够消除这点主动权，通常就称为“取得均势”，不过这里的“均势”只是一种相对的说法。
en_before: In the opening of the game, White holds a small initiative thanks to the right of the first move (let us say, after 1. d4, Black is deprived of the reply 1... e5). If Black succeeds in neutralising even such a slight initiative in the opening, then it is customary to consider that he has equalised the game, though, in the present case, the term "equalisation" bears a particularly conditional character.
en_after: In the opening of the game, White holds a small initiative thanks to the right of the first move (let us say, after 1. d4, Black is deprived of the reply 1... e5). If Black succeeds in neutralising even such a slight initiative in the opening, then it is customary to consider that he has equalised the game, though, in the present case, the term "equalisation" bears a particularly conditional character.

zh_before: 碰巧开口是对称形成的。．有时会在四马开局、法兰西防御的兑换变例、意大利对局甚至后翼弃兵中观察到这种情况。通常情况下，白方会在对称系统中成功获得小主动权，这再次归功于先手棋。
zh_after: 有些开局会形成对称局面，例如四马开局、法兰西防御兑换变例、意大利开局，甚至后翼弃兵。在对称体系中，白方也往往能凭借先行之利争取到轻微的主动权。
en_before: It happens that an opening develops symmetrically. ． This is observed sometimes in the Four Knights Opening, in the exchange variation of the French Defence, in the Italian Game and even in the Queen's Gambit. More often than not, White succeeds in obtaining a small initiative in symmetrical systems, once again thanks to having the first move.
en_after: It happens that an opening develops symmetrically. ． This is observed sometimes in the Four Knights Opening, in the exchange variation of the French Defence, in the Italian Game and even in the Queen's Gambit. More often than not, White succeeds in obtaining a small initiative in symmetrical systems, once again thanks to having the first move.

zh_before: 抓住主动权绝对是一项创造性成就。这种优势的程度取决于主动权的性格和强度。
zh_after: 夺取主动权是棋艺创造的一项成果。这种优势有多大，取决于主动权的性质和强度。
en_before: Seizing the initiative is a definite creative achievement. The extent of this advantage depends on the character and strength of the initiative.
en_after: Seizing the initiative is a definite creative achievement. The extent of this advantage depends on the character and strength of the initiative.

zh_before: 且不说持有主动权纯粹的国际象棋优势，我们可以大胆地认为它能唤起创造热情，激发思维和想象力工作效率的提高，增强对自身实力的信心。另一方面，招架对手主动权的需要常常会产生灾难性的心理影响，对对局质量、防守稳定性产生负面影响，有时还会导致士气低落。相当大比例的错误和疏忽都是由在对局中受到对手主动权影响的棋手造成的，这并非巧合。
zh_after: 掌握主动权的好处并不限于棋盘本身。它还能激发构思的热情，促使思考和想象更加活跃，增强自信。反过来，不断应付对手威胁，往往会造成沉重的心理压力，损害行棋质量和防守的韧性，甚至令人丧失斗志。实战中，相当多的错误和漏算发生在受对手压制的一方身上，这并非偶然。
en_before: Without mentioning the purely chess advantages of holding the initiative, one can boldly maintain that it evokes creative enthusiasm, stimulates an increase in work-rate of thought and imagination, promotes confidence in one's own strength. On the other hand, the need to parry the opponent's initiative quite often has a disastrous psychological influence, having a negative effect on the quality of play, on thes steadfastness of defence, and at times leads to demoralisation. It is no coincidence that a sizeable proportion of mistakes and oversights fall to the lot of chessplayers who come under the influence of the opponent's initiative in a game.
en_after: Without mentioning the purely chess advantages of holding the initiative, one can boldly maintain that it evokes creative enthusiasm, stimulates an increase in work-rate of thought and imagination, promotes confidence in one's own strength. On the other hand, the need to parry the opponent's initiative quite often has a disastrous psychological influence, having a negative effect on the quality of play, on thes steadfastness of defence, and at times leads to demoralisation. It is no coincidence that a sizeable proportion of mistakes and oversights fall to the lot of chessplayers who come under the influence of the opponent's initiative in a game.

zh_before: 白方比较发达，在中心释放了一个格给车，从那里，面对敌人后，可以轻松支撑中心的压力。这种合理的想法使得对手很难在开局时解决清算问题，并且当机会出现时也很难接管主动权。
zh_after: 白方出子领先，并为车腾出中心格，让车与黑后相对，支援中心施压。这一合理构想，使黑方难以顺利解决开局问题，更难在适当时机反夺主动权。
en_before: White is better developed and frees a square in the centre for the rook, from where, vis-a-vis the enemy queen, it will handily support the pressure in the centre. This reasonable idea makes it very difficult for the opponent to solve the problem of liquidation in the opening and, when the opportunity presents itself, also to take over the initiative.

zh_before: 玩得大胆又有趣。诚然，博列斯拉夫斯基自己指出“这是一个冒险的举动！白方本质上削弱了 e4 格，黑方从此在吃掉它的基础上构建了他的棋局。更小心的是 13. f3，避免了主动权的争夺，但保持了稳固的位置。”然而，在争夺主动权的斗争中，有时值得冒险，特别是如果考虑到拒绝这样的斗争不仅代表着棋局的投降，而且代表着一种心理立场的投降。
zh_after: 大胆而有趣。博列斯拉夫斯基却评道：“这步有风险！白方明显削弱了e4，黑方接下来便以占领这个格为目标。13. f3更谨慎，虽然放弃争夺主动权，却能保持稳固的局面。”然而，为争取主动权而冒一定风险，有时是值得的；放弃争夺，不仅意味着棋盘上的退让，也可能意味着心理上的退让。
en_before: Boldly and interestingly played. Admittedly, Boleslavsky himself noted "A risky move! White essentially weakens the e4 square, on the capture of which Black henceforth builds his game. More careful was 13. f3, refraining from the struggle for the initiative, but retaining a solid position." And yet in the struggle for the initiative it is sometimes worth taking risks, particularly if it is taken into account that refusing such a struggle represents a surrender not only of a chess, but also a psychological position.

More careful was 13. f3, refraining from the struggle for the initiative, but retaining a solid position." And yet in the struggle for the initiative it is sometimes worth taking risks, particularly if it is taken into account that refusing such a struggle represents a surrender not only of a chess, but also a psychological position.

en_before: An interesting game in which the role of the initiative was expressed very boldly. For the first ten moves, White held quite firmly a small opening initiative. He succeeded in accomplishing this as a result of White's mistake on the 23rd move.

en_before: Black's initiative increased to a "crescendo" and quickly reached the force of a decisive attack, which already after eight moves achieved its objective. Mention should be made of the exceptional harmony yin the final attacking operation of all Black's pieces.
en_after: Black's initiative increased to a "crescendo" and quickly reached the force of a decisive attack, which already after eight moves achieved its objective. Mention should be made of the exceptional harmony yin the final attacking operation of all Black's pieces.

zh_before: 主动权 - 这是国际象棋中创造性生活的象征。主动权 - 是被动和不活动、等待调动和自满沉思的敌人。这就是为什么，在国际象棋斗争的每一个时期，无论是防守还是进攻，是招架还是打击，在艰难的考验和胜利的思想时刻，我们都应该记住，始终随处伴随着我们的灵感和创造性思维的永恒口号一定是：“对主动权的渴望！”。
zh_after: 主动权象征着国际象棋创造的活力，与消极被动、无所作为、等待调动和自满观望格格不入。因此，在斗争的每个阶段，无论防守还是进攻，无论化解威胁还是实施打击，无论经受考验还是实现构想，都应让同一个信念贯穿我们的思考：“力争主动权！”
en_before: The initiative - this is a symbol of creative life in chess. The initiative - is an enemy of passivity and inactivity, waiting manoeuvring and complacent contemplation. This is why, in each period of the chess struggle, defending Or attacking, parrying or delivering blows, in moments of difficult trials and triumphant ideas, we ought to remember that the unfailing slogan, always and everywhere accompanying our inspired and creative thoughts, must be the slogan: "The desire for the initiative!".
en_after: The initiative - this is a symbol of creative life in chess. The initiative - is an enemy of passivity and inactivity, waiting manoeuvring and complacent contemplation. This is why, in each period of the chess struggle, defending Or attacking, parrying or delivering blows, in moments of difficult trials and triumphant ideas, we ought to remember that the unfailing slogan, always and everywhere accompanying our inspired and creative thoughts, must be the slogan: "The desire for the initiative!".

zh_before: 众所周知，棋子的相对强度是一个可变值，它可以根据其他棋子的排列和位置的动态而增加或减少。
zh_after: 众所周知，棋子的相对价值并非固定不变，而会随着其他子力的配置和局面的动态变化而提高或降低。
en_before: It is generally well-known that the relative strength of the pieces is a variable value which can both increase or decrease depending on the arrangement of other pieces and the dynamics of the position.
en_after: It is generally well-known that the relative strength of the pieces is a variable value which can both increase or decrease depending on the arrangement of other pieces and the dynamics of the position.

zh_before: 开放线上的车和象、占据弱格的马——这些因素都会增强子力的活性。铁马的威力往往很大，通常足以让对手即使多半子也难以发挥优势。业余棋手总爱问马和象谁更强，标准答案是：在某种局面中象更强，在另一种局面中马更强。这取决于棋盘上的兵力配置、兵形，以及力量相近的棋子首先占据了哪些位置；当然，其他棋子的位置也同样必须纳入考虑。
zh_after: 车与象占据开放线，马进驻弱格，都能增强这些棋子的威力。铁马往往威力巨大，足以抵消对手多半子的优势。业余棋手总爱问马和象谁更强，通常得到的回答是：某些局面中象更强，另一些局面中马更强。这取决于棋盘上还剩哪些兵、兵形如何，尤其取决于相互比较的棋子各自占据什么位置；当然，其他棋子的位置也必须考虑在内。
en_before: The rook and bishop on open lines, the knight established on a weak square - all these factors increase the power of piece activity. The "eternal" knight is such a threatening force that, for the most part, it is equivalent to an extra exchange for the opponent. The unfailing question of amateurs as to which is the stronger - knight or bishop, is met by the stereotyped reply: in one position the bishop is stronger, in another - the knight. It all depends s on what pawn material is on the board, what is its structure and what positions, in the first instance, the pieces, comparative in strength, are occupying. It goes without saying, the position of the other pieces must likewise be taken into account.
en_after: The rook and bishop on open lines, the knight established on a weak square - all these factors increase the power of piece activity. The "eternal" knight is such a threatening force that, for the most part, it is equivalent to an extra exchange for the opponent. The unfailing question of amateurs as to which is the stronger - knight or bishop, is met by the stereotyped reply: in one position the bishop is stronger, in another - the knight. It all depends s on what pawn material is on the board, what is its structure and what positions, in the first instance, the pieces, comparative in strength, are occupying. It goes without saying, the position of the other pieces must likewise be taken into account.

zh_before: 在这些棋子中，其力量根据位置特征和活动的和谐程度而明显增加，双象自本世纪初以来特别受到关注。
zh_after: 有些棋子的威力会因局面的特点和子力间的协调配合而显著增强。在这方面，双象自本世纪初以来便格外引人关注。
en_before: Among those pieces whose strength increases appreciably depending on the features of the position and the harmony of activity, the two bishops have attracted particular attention since the beginning of the century.
en_after: Among those pieces whose strength increases appreciably depending on the features of the position and the harmony of activity, the two bishops have attracted particular attention since the beginning of the century.

zh_before: 在多场对局中，根据位置条件，双象能够展现出自己的威胁力量，超过另外两个轻子，有时甚至超过车和轻子。
zh_after: 在许多对局中，双象借助有利的局面条件，展现出超过另外两枚轻子的威力，有时甚至胜过一车加一枚轻子。
en_before: In a number of games, according to the positional conditions, the two bishops were able to show themselves as a threatening force, exceeding the power of two other minor pieces and sometimes even a rook and minor piece.
en_after: In a number of games, according to the positional conditions, the two bishops were able to show themselves as a threatening force, exceeding the power of two other minor pieces and sometimes even a rook and minor piece.

zh_before: 局面型下法的创始人兼教师斯坦尼茨似乎对双象和谐活动的有效性着迷，并称其为“双象的优势”。这里的双象数字，以及许多其他评估中的一样，作为一个抽象的位置因素，体现了优势的一个方面。
zh_after: 作为局面型下法的奠基者，斯坦尼茨似乎陶醉于双象协调配合所产生的威力，并将它称为“双象优势”。在这里，以及在许多其他局面评价中，双象被视为一种抽象的局面因素，本身便构成一种优势。
en_before: Steinitz, the founder-teacher of positional play, seemed to be carried away with the effectiveness of the harmonious activity of the two bishops and called this "the advantage of the two bishops". The two bishops figure here, as also in many other evaluations, as an abstract positional factor, embodying one aspect of the advantage.
en_after: Steinitz, the founder-teacher of positional play, seemed to be carried away with the effectiveness of the harmonious activity of the two bishops and called this "the advantage of the two bishops". The two bishops figure here, as also in many other evaluations, as an abstract positional factor, embodying one aspect of the advantage.

zh_before: 第一个坚决反对这种观点的是齐果林。当世界冠军的书《国际象棋常识》于 1896 年出版时，他在与拉斯克的争论中非常彻底地阐述了他对这个问题的看法。 拉斯克为他在伦敦棋手观众面前发表的十二个演讲集起了这个大胆的名字。这里没有地方评估这部作品的优点和缺点，尽管它自命不凡，但无疑值得关注。然而，我们只记得它与一个立场有关，由于该立场，齐果林和拉斯克之间就我们对双象感兴趣的问题产生了争议。
zh_after: 齐果林首先明确反对这一观点。1896年，世界冠军拉斯克的《国际象棋常识》出版后，齐果林在与他的论争中详细阐述了自己的看法。该书汇集了拉斯克在伦敦面向棋手所作的十二次讲座，书名颇有气魄。这里无意评论这本著作的得失；它虽有自负之处，却无疑值得重视。我们提到它，只是因为书中的一个局面引发了齐果林与拉斯克关于双象的争论。
en_before: The first to come out decisively against this view was Chigorin. He expounded his views on this question very thoroughly in polemics with Em.Lasker, when the world champion's book Common Sense in Chess was published in 1896. Lasker gave this bold name to a collection of twelve lectures which he had given before an audience of London chessplayers. There is no place here to assess the merits and demerits of this work which, though pretentious, undoubtedly deserves attention. However, we recall it solely in connection with one position, on account of which arose a dispute between Chigorin and Lasker on the question which interests us about the two bishops.

zh_before: 我们对齐果林对这一评估的反对意见发表在1897年1月30日《Novoe Vremya》报纸的国际象棋专栏中：“通过指出双象，拉斯克先生自然地给出了这样的理解：双象在力量上优于两个马。因此，还考虑到力量的出色发展在“强”位置上，黑方对对手有显着的优势，并且有获胜的机会。然而，在我看来，Herr 拉斯克对局面的评估完全是主观的，并且在实践中很难证明是正确的。他不仅没有证实这一点，即使只是对位置进行了肤浅的分析，而且也没有向那些对双象更感兴趣的问题解释什么。在目前的位置上有超过两个马的“力量”，他们将扮演什么角色？
zh_after: 下面引述齐果林对这一评价的反驳，原文刊于1897年1月30日《新时代报》的国际象棋专栏：“拉斯克先生特意指出双象，自然是认为双象的力量胜过双马。那么，再加上出子充分和‘坚固’的阵地，黑方就应当明显占优，并且大有获胜希望。然而在我看来，拉斯克先生对局面的评价完全出于主观，实战恐怕很难证实。他没有提供哪怕粗略的局面分析来支持这一判断，也没有回答业余棋手更关心的问题：在这个具体局面中，双象究竟怎样体现出超过双马的‘力量’，又能发挥什么作用？
en_before: We give Chigorin's objection to this assessment which appeared on 30January 1897 in the（ chess column of the newspaper Novoe Vremya: "By indicating the two bishops, Herr Lasker naturally gives the understanding that the two bishops are superior in strength to the two knights. Consequently, taking into account also the excellent development of forces and the "strong" position, the Black player has a significant advantage over the opponent and every chance of victory. However, the assessment of the position, made by Herr Lasker, in my opinion is totally subjective eand hardly proves to be correct in practice. He e not only does not confirm this, even if only with a superficial analysis of the position, but also explains nothing to the amateur who is interested more in the question: in what way can the two bishops show their "strength" over two knights in the present position, and what role will they play?

zh_after: 有趣的是，拉斯克先生所给变化中的局面也可能出现在实战中。因此，我怀着兴趣对它作了研究，却得出了完全相反的结论：局面的种种有利条件都在白方一边。我想，详细的分析和实战检验甚至会证明，黑方的局面已经无可挽救。
en_before: It is interesting that the position reached in Herr Lasker's variation can also be obtained in the practical game. Therefore, being personally y interested in it, I endeavoured to investigate it. But my analysis led to a completely opposite conclusion, i.e. that all the advantages in the position are to be found on White's side. It would hardly be a mistake to say that detailed analysis and practice will prove that Black's position is even irreparable.

zh_before: 应该补充的是，在实践中，“象崇拜者”也经常偏离自己的原则。拉斯克他自己多次使用了西班牙开局的兑换变例并且总是成功，其中白方让对手从第一个开局就拥有了“双象的优势”。而他的对手虽然也有s塔拉什、雅诺夫斯基、卡帕布兰卡等优秀选手，其中前两位也是众所周知的“双象专家”，但他们却无法利用这股力量抵消拉斯克在王翼上额外的兵。
zh_after: 还应指出，实战中那些“崇拜象”的棋手，也常常偏离自己的原则。拉斯克就多次成功地采用西班牙开局兑换变例，在开局最初几步便让对手获得所谓“双象优势”。他的对手不乏塔拉什、雅诺夫斯基和卡帕布兰卡这样的杰出棋手；前两位还是公认的“双象专家”。即使如此，他们也未能利用双象抵消拉斯克王翼多兵的优势。
en_before: It should be added that in practice also "bishop-worshippers" not infrequently deviate from their own principles. Lasker himself, many times and invariably with success, employed the exchange variation of the Spanish Game in which White lets the opponent have the "advantage of the two bishops" from the first opening moves. And though his opponents also included such noutstanding players as s Tarrasch, Janowski, Capablanca and others, the first two of whom were also well-known "specialists with the two bishops", even they could not utilise this force to offset Lasker's extra pawn on the king's flank.

zh_before: 我们已经指出，关于两个b象优势的“理论”诞生的基础在于双象的联合活动所表现出的力量大大超过了另外两个轻子的战斗力。但是，你知道，除了这些位置之外，还有许多其他位置双象对象和马甚至两个马无能为力 - 这是第一件事。其次，对象的权力与其活动的和谐性不成比例地增加的位置进行不带偏见的审查表明，这并不是来自某种神奇的力量，就好像双象固有的那样，而是来自许多位置因素的有利组合。我们来看几个这样的例子。
zh_after: 前面已经指出，“双象优势”理论源于这样一些局面：双象协同作战的威力远远超过另外两枚轻子。然而，首先，也有许多局面中双象无力对抗象马，甚至无力对抗双马。其次，若不带成见地分析那些双象因协调配合而威力大增的局面，就会发现，这种力量并非双象与生俱来的某种魔力，而是多种有利的局面因素共同作用的结果。下面来看几个例子。
en_before: We have already pointed out that the basis for the birth of the "theory" about the advantage of the two b bishops lies in positions where the joint activity of the two bishops displays a power which considerably exceeds the fighting capacity of two other minor pieces. But, you know, besides such positions there are many others in which two bishops are powerless against bishop and knight or even two knights - this is the first thing. And, secondly, an unprejudiced examination of positions where the power of the bishops increases disproportionately to the harmony of their activity shows that this does not spring from some magical force, as if inherent in the two bishops, but from a favourable combination of a number of positional factors. We turn to a few such examples.

zh_before: 从抽象的推理来看，可以说白马占据了辉煌的位置。但唯一值得问的问题是，在目前的情况下，他的“辉煌”马能带来什么具体的好处，除了它切断了黑方后与e3格的事实之外，几乎没有任何好处。

en_before: With abstract reasoning, one could say that the White knight occupies a splendid position. But the only question worth asking is what concrete benefit can be derived in the present position from his "splendid" knight, which there and then turns out to be almost none v whatsoever, apart from the fact that it cuts off the Black queen from the e3 square.
en_after: With abstract reasoning, one could say that the White knight occupies a splendid position. But the only question worth asking is what concrete benefit can be derived in the present position from his "splendid" knight, which there and then turns out to be almost none v whatsoever, apart from the fact that it cuts off the Black queen from the e3 square.

zh_before: 我们不能不回想起齐果林的黄金言论，即棋子的强度不是由其位置（静态！）决定的，而是由其具体行动前景（动态！）决定的。
zh_after: 这使我们不禁想起齐果林的至理名言：棋子的力量不由它所在的位置（静态因素）决定，而由它具体的行动前景（动态因素）决定。
en_before: We cannot but recall the words of gold of Chigorin about the fact that the strength of a piece is determined not by its location (static!) but its concrete prospects of action (dynamic!).
en_after: We cannot but recall the words of gold of Chigorin about the fact that the strength of a piece is determined not by its location (static!) but its concrete prospects of action (dynamic!).

zh_before: 白方唯一的动态机会（他也尝试过）包括冲兵，但他的棋子，特别是王的悲惨位置，注定了这个计划的失败。
zh_after: 白方唯一能争取的动态机会是冲起h兵，实战中他也作了这一尝试；但他的子力，尤其是王的位置太差，这个计划注定无法成功。
en_before: White's only dynamic chance, which he also tries, consists of the advance of the h-pawn, but the miserable position of his pieces, and particularly the king, dooms this plan to failure.
en_after: White's only dynamic chance, which he also tries, consists of the advance of the h-pawn, but the miserable position of his pieces, and particularly the king, dooms this plan to failure.

zh_before: 难道说黑方是凭借“双象的优势”取得了胜利吗？当然不是！白方由于其棋局中的许多位置弱点以及他的王暴露的位置（卡在中间）而输掉了对局。可以肯定地说，如果不是对手的象，而是他的马，放在d3上，那么同样白方也无法挽救对局。
zh_after: 能说黑方是凭借“双象优势”获胜的吗？当然不能。白方失败的原因，是自己阵地中存在许多弱点，而王仍困在中心、暴露无遗。可以肯定，即使d3上不是黑象而是黑马，白方同样无法挽救局面。
en_before: Can it be said that Black gained victory due to the "advantage of the two bishops"? Of course not! White lost as a consequence of the many positional weaknesses in his game and the exposed position of his king, stuck in the centre. One can say with confidence that if it were not the opponent's bishop, but his knight, which was placed on d3, then likewise White would not have saved the game.
en_after: Can it be said that Black gained victory due to the "advantage of the two bishops"? Of course not! White lost as a consequence of the many positional weaknesses in his game and the exposed position of his king, stuck in the centre. One can say with confidence that if it were not the opponent's bishop, but his knight, which was placed on d3, then likewise White would not have saved the game.

zh_before: 因此，对于在评估一个位置时，是否应该将其中一个对手的双象的存在因素作为优势的一个特定方面考虑在内的问题，在我们看来，正确的答案是——不，不应该。
zh_after: 因此，评价局面时，是否应把一方拥有双象本身视为一项独立的优势？我们的回答是否定的。
en_before: Thus to the question whether, in evaluating a position, the factor of the presence of the two bishops for one of the opponents should be taken into account as a particular aspect of the advantage, the right reply, in our view, will be - no, it should not.
en_after: Thus to the question whether, in evaluating a position, the factor of the presence of the two bishops for one of the opponents should be taken into account as a particular aspect of the advantage, the right reply, in our view, will be - no, it should not.

zh_before: 这一特定方面的优势并不存在，就像不存在“两个马”、““两个车”等优势一样。正如马对弱格的利用一样，象的活动强化是基于弱格的复合体或该职位的其他弱点，基于给出整体的具体位置。
zh_after: 在我们看来，并不存在这样一种独立的优势，正如不存在“双马优势”或“双车优势”一样。马利用弱格才能发挥威力；同样，象的作用增强，也依赖于一组弱格或其他局面弱点，归根结底取决于整个具体局面的特点。
en_before: This particular aspect of the advantage does not exist, as does not exist the advantage of the "two knights", ""two rooks" etc. Just as the exploitation of a weak square by the knight, the intensification of activity by the bishops is based on a complex of weak squares or other weaknesses of the position, on the features of a given concrete position as a whole.
en_after: This particular aspect of the advantage does not exist, as does not exist the advantage of the "two knights", ""two rooks" etc. Just as the exploitation of a weak square by the knight, the intensification of activity by the bishops is based on a complex of weak squares or other weaknesses of the position, on the features of a given concrete position as a whole.
